scope: Captured invitation scoped fixture; no auth internals or application data

rows.name: organization_audit_log_actor_user_id_fkey
rows.definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

rows.name: organization_audit_log_organization_id_fkey
rows.definition: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

rows.name: organization_audit_log_pkey
rows.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

rows.name: organization_invitations_invited_by_fkey
rows.definition: FOREIGN KEY (invited_by) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

rows.name: organization_invitations_organization_id_fkey
rows.definition: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

rows.name: organization_invitations_pkey
rows.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

rows.name: organization_invitations_role_check
rows.definition: CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'manager'::text, 'member'::text, 'viewer'::text])))

rows.name: organization_invitations_token_hash_key
rows.definition: UNIQUE (token_hash)

rows.name: organization_members_organization_id_fkey
rows.definition: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES public.organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

rows.name: organization_members_pkey
rows.definition: PRIMARY KEY (organization_id, user_id)

rows.name: organization_members_role_check
rows.definition: CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'manager'::text, 'member'::text, 'viewer'::text])))

rows.name: organization_members_user_id_fkey
rows.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

rows.name: organizations_name_check
rows.definition: CHECK (((char_length(name) >= 2) AND (char_length(name) <= 120)))

rows.name: organizations_owner_user_id_fkey
rows.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

rows.name: organizations_pkey
rows.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

rows.name: organizations_slug_key
rows.definition: UNIQUE (slug)

rows.name: profiles_id_fkey
rows.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

rows.name: profiles_pkey
rows.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

rows.name: profiles_plan_check
rows.definition: CHECK ((plan = ANY (ARRAY['free'::text, 'pro'::text, 'business'::text])))

rows.name: user_preferences_pkey
rows.definition: PRIMARY KEY (user_id)

rows.name: user_preferences_unit_system_check
rows.definition: CHECK ((unit_system = ANY (ARRAY['metric'::text, 'us'::text])))

rows.name: user_preferences_user_id_fkey
rows.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

rows.name: invites_admin_insert
rows.check: (public.has_org_role(organization_id, ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text]) AND (invited_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))

rows.name: on_auth_user_created
rows.definition: CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, display_name, plan)
  values (new.id, coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'display_name', new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'), 'free')
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  insert into public.user_preferences (user_id)
  values (new.id)
  on conflict (user_id) do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_org_role(target_org uuid, allowed_roles text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(public.org_role(target_org) = any(allowed_roles), false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_org_member(target_org uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1 from public.organization_members m
    where m.organization_id = target_org and m.user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.org_role(target_org uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select m.role from public.organization_members m
  where m.organization_id = target_org and m.user_id = auth.uid()
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX organization_members_pkey ON public.organization_members USING btree (organization_id, user_id)
CREATE INDEX organization_members_user_idx ON public.organization_members USING btree (user_id)
CREATE INDEX organizations_owner_user_id_fk_idx ON public.organizations USING btree (owner_user_id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_preferences_pkey ON public.user_preferences USING btree (user_id)
